Silt Echo trails — when the Kraken's tentacles pass over the player's resonance trails, they vibrate at unstable frequencies, temporarily paralyzing its limbs

Resonant Core — its body is covered in inscribed runic plates that resonate with specific frequencies. Firing the correct pulse from the Resonant Core (learned from the Kraken's pattern) causes the runes to overload and crumble, exposing its vulnerable core.
Player's default 'Sonic Pulse' weapon (stuns and reveals hidden coral nests)
Resonant Tendril (its shell vibrates and cracks when exposed to the sonic frequency)
Luminous Pearl (its bioluminescence calms the creature, making it docile and vulnerable to touch)
Vulnerable to Bone Shards — shards from slain eels explode in a 3m radius when the necromancer casts 'Bone Surge'
Vulnerable to Bone Shards when they resonate with her vocal frequency — shards must be embedded into her vocal sacs using 'Bone Surge' while she sings

Vulnerable to Bone Shards only if the Corrupted Heart is active — shards become spectral when Heart is held, bypassing the Warden's bone armor. Shards must strike its hollow chest during its 2-second vulnerable window after a slam attack.

Must be stunned by the Stormcaller's first Lightning Bolt (default weapon ability) before it can be killed. Eels phase out of reality if not hit by lightning within 1.5 seconds of sighting the player.

Must be hit with the Overcharge Pulse (acquired from Encounter 1) while it is channeling energy through its central spine. The Warden is immune to all direct lightning attacks unless the Overcharge Pulse is used — it reflects normal bolts and absorbs them to heal.

Must be stunned using the Storm Core while it is actively absorbing ambient lightning from the environment. The Drone emits a sonic pulse every 7 seconds that nullifies all lightning abilities — but if the Storm Core is thrown into its absorption node during this pulse, it reverses the effect, overloading the Drone and revealing its internal core.

Shadowblade's Silent Strike — the eel is blind but detects vibration. A perfectly timed Silent Strike (player's default ability) stuns it mid-lunge, leaving it vulnerable to three consecutive slashes before it recovers.

Mute Scale — the cephalopod projects blinding bioluminescent pulses. If the player has Mute Scale active, their footsteps do not trigger its alarm pulses, allowing them to approach undetected and land a Shadowblade's Shadow Dash (high-damage mobility attack) behind it. Without Mute Scale, the pulses are unavoidable and deal stacking disorientation damage.

Echo Shard — the Sentinel is encased in a shell of solidified sound. It is immune to all physical attacks unless the player uses the Echo Shard's resonance ability to shatter its sonic armor. Each time the player lands a critical hit while the Echo Shard's aura is active, the Sentinel's shell weakens. After three shatters, it enters a vulnerable state where it can be critically hit with Shadow Strike.
